changelog: **Admin oversight of self-served credentials (#2006):** the admin integrations screen labels every API key and webhook a COMPANY or SOURCE owner minted with whose it is (`api-key-scope-owner-*`, `webhook-scope-owner-*`), next to who issued it; org-wide credentials carry no label. Pinned by `e2e/admin-integrations-owner.spec.ts`.

en: Admins can now see on the Integrations screen which company or referring organisation a self-created API key or webhook belongs to.
tr: Yöneticiler artık Entegrasyonlar ekranında, kendi oluşturulmuş bir API anahtarının veya webhook'un hangi şirkete ya da yönlendiren kuruma ait olduğunu görebiliyor.
de: Admins sehen jetzt unter Integrationen, zu welchem Unternehmen oder welcher vermittelnden Organisation ein selbst erstellter API-Schlüssel oder Webhook gehört.
